item.title: Hong Kong: PolyU Advances Intelligent Transport Solutions
item.description: Hong Kong Polytechnic University received HK$18.6 million from the Smart Traffic Fund to advance AI-driven logistics, wearable driver monitoring and bus emergency braking technologies for safer, more efficient urban transport.

item.title: Vietnam Strengthens AI Oversight as Banks Scale Digital Services
item.description: The State Bank of Vietnam is tightening AI regulations in banking, now requiring prior explicit customer notification, transparent disclosure and human oversight to ensure ethical, safe and responsible AI use.

item.title: Singapore’s Model for Safe and Responsible AI Adoption
item.description: Singapore translates AI safety research into practical laws, standards and comprehensive, internationally recognised frameworks, balancing innovation with safeguards to enable responsible and sustainable AI adoption regionally and globally.

item.title: India’s Agricultural Revolution Set to Be AI-Driven
item.description: India plans a major AI-driven agricultural transformation, with a national research network and tools projected to unlock US$8.9 billion annual value for farmers, while boosting productivity, efficiency and resilience.

item.title: Hong Kong: HKU Engineers Unlock Smart Acoustic Solutions
item.description: HKU engineers have developed smart ventilated acoustic materials that combine physics and AI to achieve high sound absorption without blocking airflow, transforming noise control for buildings and industry.

item.title: Thailand: Digital Transformation in Higher Education Leadership
item.description: Thailand is strengthening higher education leadership and digital-era governance through national collaboration to enhance university management, global competitiveness and sustainable national development.

item.title: Malaysia: Selangor Advances Skills to Support Smart Industries
item.description: The Selangor government is modernising its TVET programmes to equip a future-ready workforce with digital, AI, automation and smart manufacturing skills, driving inclusive industrial growth aligned with Industry 5.0 and national aspirations.

item.title: Indonesia Strengthens AI and Semiconductor Ties with India
item.description: Indonesia is actively and strategically partnering with India to advance AI and semiconductor development while promoting inclusive technology for social, economic and digital growth across the country.

item.title: Australia: NSW to Boost Clean Technology and Regional Jobs
item.description: The NSW Government has committed AU$52 million to accelerate renewable manufacturing, create and support regional jobs and advance innovative low-carbon technologies across agriculture, transport and energy systems.

item.title: Vietnam: Digital Transformation Reshapes Handicraft Exports
item.description: Vietnam’s handicraft sector is embracing digital transformation to enhance traceability, expand e-commerce reach and strengthen its position in premium global markets amid shifting supply chains and sustainability demands.
